definingMoment: Interlagos, last lap, Turn 13. Hamilton needed fifth. He passed Timo Glock's dry-tyred Toyota on the final corner of the final lap of the season to take it by one point — the smallest margin the title had been decided by since 1984.

clinched: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, Yas Marina
definingMoment: The first year of the hybrid regulations, and the first year of a rivalry conducted inside one garage. Eleven wins to Rosberg's five, settled in a double-points finale Hamilton led from the first corner.
Sealed at Austin with three races still to run, after a first-corner move on Rosberg in a race that changed condition four times. The most complete of the seven seasons.

clinched: Mexican Grand Prix, Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
definingMoment: Ferrari led the championship at the summer break. Hamilton won Spa, Monza and Singapore in sequence and the season never returned. A fourth title, and the first won against a rival in another car.

clinched: Mexican Grand Prix, Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
definingMoment: Hockenheim, from fourteenth on the grid, in a race that started dry and did not stay that way. Vettel led and crashed out. Hamilton won. The championship was effectively decided in ninety minutes.
Seventeen podiums from twenty-one starts and the highest points total of his career, built on a season with fewer poles than any title year before it. The speed moved from Saturday to Sunday.

Istanbul Park, wet, sixth on the grid, on a set of intermediate tyres taken down to the canvas across a single stint. A seventh title, equalling Michael Schumacher, in a season shortened to seventeen races.
